Method of Attack: Acts as a reverse proxy to steal credentials and MFA codes
Used in phishing attacks to bypass multi-factor authentication by intercepting login credentials and one-time passcodes
Attack Vector: Phishing emails containing links to attacker-controlled VNC servers
noVNC remote access software with browser in kiosk mode
Indicators of Compromise: Links that launch victim's browser to connect to attacker's VNC server
Date of Discovery: 2019 (Google added security feature to block reverse proxies)
